intro: The Tear of Tilloa is a delicate, pale blossom found in the shadows of Duskwood. Desired for its potent alchemical properties, it grows quietly in the overgrown grounds of the Mistmantle estate near Darkshire.

p: Growing amidst the encroaching blighted woods outside Darkshire, the Tear of Tilloa takes root within the estate grounds of Stalvan Mistmantle. Though Duskwood's soil has turned hostile to wholesome vegetation, this small white flower persists among the shadowed plots. Its scarce growth and secluded location make it an object of interest for those seeking rare reagents not easily discovered in lawful markets.
